$comment: Slot Contribution Extension Schema (Derived). What a kit puts into one of the shell's named slots (ADR-0068 §2 'section in a screen'; mfe/slots.ts): every slot domain pins this type as its extensionsTypeId, so a contribution chains through it. Modelled on extension_overlay.v1: base type pulled in via allOf, presentation required.

label.$comment: What the contribution is called: the shell names it when it does not come up.

order.$comment: Ascending within the slot; ties by extension id; undeclared goes last.

kit.$comment: The kit that brings it: shown only where that kit is installed. The shell sets it for a kit's package loaded at run time, whatever the bundle says.

level.$comment: Shown only at this level. Absent: at every level the slot is drawn on.

screen.$comment: Shown only with the screen at this route (the item's own route, its section included: '/projects/overview'). Absent: with every screen the slot is drawn on.
